constraints.definition: CHECK (((((storage)::text = 'not_persisted'::text) AND (image_blob_name IS NULL)) OR (((storage)::text = 'azure_blob'::text) AND (image_blob_name IS NOT NULL) AND ((state)::text = 'accepted'::text))))

CHECK (((engine_version IS NULL) OR ((engine_version = 2) AND (intervention IS NOT NULL) AND (routine_entry_id IS NOT NULL) AND (product_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source IS NOT NULL) AND ((source)::text = 'user_configured'::text) AND (status IS NOT NULL) AND (target_days IS NOT NULL) AND ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['draft'::character varying, 'active'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'stopped'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((target_days >= 7) AND (target_days <= 90)))))

CHECK (((engine_version IS NULL) OR ((((status)::text = 'active'::text) AND (active_owner IS NOT NULL) AND ((active_owner)::text = (user_id)::text) AND (activated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (definition_snapshot IS NOT NULL)) OR (((status)::text <> 'active'::text) AND (active_owner IS NULL)))))

FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (((active AND (end_date IS NULL)) OR ((NOT active) AND (end_date IS NOT NULL) AND (end_date >= start_date))))
